_doc: Bond Contracts: how a sapient character is acquired. Each bond is a staged, character-specific trust quest built around their contradiction (Agent 3 authors the rest of the cast; Lead validates). 'requires' maps a stage to a spec (see design/LEDGER_SPEC.md). Empty requirement = advanced manually by gameplay (Ledger.set_bond). A bond never silently disappears: failing a test sends the character to 'estranged', with an optional 'reconcile_if'.

zephyr.contradiction: Treats rules as games but treats promises as sacred.
zephyr.test_hint: Zephyr wants a promise, worded carefully. Wording is the whole art.
